text: Monaco is a European **microstate** on the French Riviera, a few kilometres west of the border with Italy.
text_zh: 摩納哥是位於法國蔚藍海岸的一個歐洲**微型國家**，距離義大利邊境以西幾公里。

text: Monaco is a **rich** and **densely populated** city state, with a Mediterranean feel to it. The architecture is similar to cities in southern France and northern Italy, but more luxurious. You will see a lot of apartment buildings, neoclassical details, and pastel colours. There are essentially no rural areas.
text_zh: 摩納哥是一個**富有**且**人口稠密**的城邦，帶有地中海風情。其建築類似於法國南部和義大利北部的城市，但更加豪華。你會看到大量的公寓大樓、新古典主義細節和粉彩色調。這裡基本上沒有鄉村地區。

text: Monaco’s licence plates are **short** and lack the blue strip.
You will still see a lot of normal French plates around, however. These French vehicles often still have the old yellow back plates, due to how old the Generation 2 coverage is.
text_zh: 摩納哥的車牌很**短**，且缺少藍色條紋。
不過，你仍然會看到許多法國的普通車牌。由於第二代街景的年代久遠，這些法國車輛通常仍帶有舊的黃色後車牌。

text: Monaco is a **hilly** country. The very few areas that are not built up show mediterranean vegetation.
text_zh: 摩納哥是一個**多山**的國家。極少數未開發的地區則展現出地中海植被。
人工種植的**棕櫚樹**很常見。

text: There is a lot of coverage inside **tunnels**.
Rows of parked **mopeds** are a common sight around Monaco’s streets.
text_zh: 一排排停放的**輕型機車**是摩納哥街頭常見的景象。

text: In the harbour, there is an extensive **Generation 3 trekker on a boat**. The Google employee’s brown hair and sunglasses are visible. You can see Monaco’s skyline and the hills beyond it. There are a lot of expensive [yachts](https://goo.gl/maps/4Z8rnvc99PPCqQEL7) around.
This trekker shows up a lot in the official competitive game modes, so it is worth remembering.
text_zh: 在港口裡，有一台 uitgebreide 的**船上第三代徒步拍攝**。Google 員工的棕色頭髮和太陽眼鏡清晰可見。你可以看到摩納哥的天際線以及它後方的山丘。周圍有許多昂貴的[遊艇](https://goo.gl/maps/4Z8rnvc99PPCqQEL7)。
這個徒步拍攝在官方競賽遊戲模式中經常出現，所以很值得記住。
